test_title: PYST 13: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two Statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some vowels are digits.

2. Some digits are consonants.

**Conclusions:**

I. No consonant is a vowel.

II. No digit is a vowel.

III. Some consonants are vowels.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or III follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f635acdde3977e0da7ccb745a552d1597babf13988c5f26f20444ff361c950af.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No consonant is a vowel → Can't say as there is No clear relation is given between Vowel and consonants

II. No digit is a vowel → False → According to Statement 1.

III. Some consonants are vowels → False → (It is possible but not definite).

Both **conclusions I and III form a complementary pair**, hence either I or III follows.

Hence, **Option (4)** is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

A set of two conclusions is said to be a Complementary Pair and thus form a case of **either or** when they follow the following conditions-

i) Both the objects must be the same in both conclusions.

ii) Both the conclusions must be False individually.

Some of the cases of complementary pairs are-

Some + No & All + Some Not 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

**Some + Some not **is never a complimentary pair.
